description: React component for editing incoming webhooks in Mattermost, including fetching, updating, and rendering the webhook editing UI.

classes.name: EditIncomingWebhook
classes.description: React component class for editing incoming webhooks, managing state, fetching webhook data, and handling updates.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method to fetch incoming webhook data when component mounts.

methods.name: editIncomingHook
methods.description: Handles editing and setting the new webhook data, then submits the update.

methods.name: submitHook
methods.description: Submits the updated webhook data to the server and handles success or error.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the webhook editing UI or loading screen if webhook data is not yet available.
